Republic of the Philippines
Province of Valenzuela
City of Valenzuela
Sangguniang Panlungsod

OFFICE OF THE CITY LEGISLATIVE

ORDINANCE NO. 2026-0042

Series of 2026

AN ORDINANCE APPROPRIATING THE AMOUNT OF TWENTY-FIVE MILLION PESOS (₱25,000,000.00) FOR THE CONSTRUCTION AND IMPROVEMENT OF PUBLIC SCHOOLS IN THE CITY OF VALENZUELA, AUTHORIZING THE CITY MAYOR TO ENTER INTO CONTRACTS AND AGREEMENTS NECESSARY THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES

Authored by: Hon. Maria Clara Santos
Co-Authored by: Hon. Juan Dela Cruz, Hon. Roberto Reyes

Passed by the Sangguniang Panlungsod on January 15, 2026
Approved by the City Mayor on January 20, 2026
Reference Number: SP-2026-0042-ORD

WHEREAS, the Constitution of the Philippines mandates the State to protect and promote the right of all citizens to quality education at all levels;

WHEREAS, the City Government of Valenzuela has allocated funds in the Annual Budget for Fiscal Year 2026 for infrastructure projects related to education;

WHEREAS, there is an urgent need to construct and improve public school buildings to accommodate the growing student population in the city;

NOW, THEREFORE, be it ordained by the Sangguniang Panlungsod of Valenzuela in regular session assembled:

Section 1. Appropriation. The amount of TWENTY-FIVE MILLION PESOS (₱25,000,000.00) is hereby appropriated from the General Fund for CY 2026 for the construction and improvement of public schools in the City of Valenzuela.

Section 2. Scope of Projects. The appropriation shall cover the following:
   (a) Construction of new classroom buildings;
   (b) Repair and rehabilitation of existing school facilities;
   (c) Procurement of furniture and fixtures;
   (d) Related infrastructure improvements.

Section 3. Implementation. The City Mayor, through the City Engineering Office and the Division of City Schools, shall implement the projects herein authorized.

Section 4. Authority to Contract. The City Mayor is hereby authorized to enter into contracts, agreements, and memoranda of understanding with contractors, suppliers, and other parties necessary for the implementation of this Ordinance.

Section 5. Reporting. The City Mayor shall submit quarterly reports to the Sangguniang Panlungsod on the status of implementation and utilization of the funds herein appropriated.

Section 6. Separability Clause. If any provision of this Ordinance is declared invalid or unconstitutional, the remaining provisions not affected thereby shall remain in full force and effect.

Section 7. Repealing Clause. All ordinances, rules, and regulations or parts thereof inconsistent with this Ordinance are hereby repealed or amended accordingly.

Section 8. Effectivity. This Ordinance shall take effect immediately upon approval.

APPROVED this 20th day of January, 2026.

CERTIFIED TRUE AND CORRECT:

Attested by:
City Council Secretary
City Government of Valenzuela

APPROVED:

HON. WEXICA GALANG
City Mayor
City of Valenzuela
